name: Masono Seiji
source:
A talented systems engineer who puts work first.

He's always been devoted to his wife, but in an effort to reassure her, he prioritizes work and is therefore indifferent to sex.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/tanshin_furin/]official site[/url]]
